message: The other day, I found my son rummaging through his backpack, pulling out all the snacks I’d packed for our last outing. I couldn’t help but chuckle—he was so sure we wouldn’t need that extra water bottle. But guess what? We ended up stuck in traffic for an hour! It felt like a little victory to have been prepared. 😊 Sometimes those 'I told you so' moments are just reminders that a little planning can go a long way. What’s your best tip for staying ready at home?
